title: Neuro-Cognitive AI Fingerprinting for Pre-Radiographic Brain Tumor Detection Using Transformer-Based Phase-Amplitude Coupling Analysis
journal: International Journal of Advanced Research in Science, Communication and Technology (IJARSCT)
institution: MIT School of Computing, MIT-ADT University
abstract: Early identification of intracranial space-occupying lesions remains critical to clinical prognosis. This paper presents an experimental biomarker pipeline evaluating Phase-Amplitude Coupling (PAC) across theta-gamma frequency bands coupled with non-invasive gait, speech, and ocular latency metrics. Evaluated against synthetic EEG traces and physiological benchmarks, the proposed self-attention Transformer framework achieved 87.4% preclinical anomaly detection accuracy.
